messages:
incident-bot: SEV1 triggered: hosted-api(us-west2) p99 > 12s, queued_requests > 20k, autoscaler failing to create GPUs. Paging SRE oncall.

Sahil: I'm on. Looking at dashboards and logs. Queue graph looks like sudden climb at 1992345600.

Emily: Quick metrics dump:
```
avg_over_time(hosted_api_queue{region="us-west2"}[5m]) = 18472
sum(autoscaler_errors{region="us-west2"}) by (error) => {QUOTA_EXCEEDED: 18, API_RATE_LIMIT: 3}
```
Autoscaler receiving quota errors when hitting cloud API.

AJ: Confirmed cloud error from provisioner: "Quota 'GPUS' has no remaining quota for region us-west2". Looks like we exhausted pre-approved GPU quota. Are we recently added a new model rollout?

Sahil: Not that I know. Could be a customer traffic blitz. Immediate triage plan:
- throttle non-SLO customers to 20% of normal
- switch non-critical keys to small-quantized model
- spin up CPU fallback instances for best-effort traffic
- open cloud quota support case and PM escalation

ops-bot: cloud-provisioner:create_instance_group failed -> 403 QuotaError: "Requested 8 GPUs, available 0". request_id=gtx-7782

Maria (support): I'm seeing numerous support tickets and a spike in 502s for hosted-api. Raising status page to "degraded". Notifying top paying customers.

AJ: Pushing route rule now. Patch below:
```
POST /routing/v1/update
payload: { "when": "tier!=enterprise", "to_model": "tiny-quant-v2", "max_qps": 0.6 }
```
Applying.

Emily: Route rule applied. Telemetry: rerouted keys p95 dropped 70% to ~800ms. Global queue decreased to ~11k (from 20k). But overall p99 still high for enterprise tenants — they remained on the larger model.

Sahil: Can we briefly divert enterprise tenants to us-east1 as emergency failover? Need to weigh cross-region latency impact vs timeouts. Infra constraints maybe config-only.

Alex: I can prepare cross-region policies. However provisioning more GPUs in us-east1 is also subject to quota. Alternative: warm a small number of dedicated-burst nodes (reserved pool) and shift enterprise traffic there. That requires infra approval.

ops-bot: manual scale attempt -> gcloud compute instances create-for-gpu --count=16
ERROR: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Available: 0

Sahil: Opening cloud support ticket: CLD-998877. Pinged account manager for emergency quota bump. In parallel: enable an aggressive global soft-rate-limit for API keys with 'play' or 'dev' tags.

Maria (support): Status updated: "Hosted API partial outage in us-west2 — mitigation in progress; some customers may experience errors or degraded model responses."

AJ: I'm starting CPU fallback fleet for tiny-quant-v2 on c2-standard nodes, pulling docker image redwood/model-tiny-cpu:prod. Starting 10 instances now.

ops-bot: cpu-fallback: launched 10 instances, attached to pool cpu-fallback-us-west2.

Emily: Early numbers: cpu pool handling ~15% of incoming token throughput; queue falling to ~7.5k. p99 for mixed traffic still ~6s.

Sahil: Handing off to night oncall @Alex at 1992345900. Current actions for Alex:
1) monitor cloud ticket and confirm quota bump
2) coordinate with infra to prefer reserved burst pool for top-5 tenants
3) if quota not granted in 90m, initiate cross-region failover plan for enterprise traffic

Alex: Taking handoff — will keep thread updated. If quota not granted, I'll start migration playbook for top-5 tenants to us-east1 and change DNS/routing.

Maria (support): CS has escalated to three enterprise contacts. Sending status templates for SLA exposure. Tracking 502/504 count = 124 in last 30m.

infra-lead: FYI we've noted a trend of higher GPU utilization in us-west2 due to new customer onboardings last month; request a permanent quota increase proposal. Filing infra ticket INFRA-4732.

Sahil: Please also add a short-term policy: allow autoscaler to prefer heterogeneous GPUs (fallback to a smaller SKU) when primary SKU quota is exhausted. That may avoid full provisioning failure.

ops-bot: autoscaler config patch applied: prefer_alternate_gpu_sku=true for hosted-us-west2.

Emily: After preference change, autoscaler successfully created 8 nodes with alternate-sku-16gb. Queue now ~4200 and trending down. p99 across tenants dropping to ~2.1s.

Sahil: Great. Cloud ticket still open but we've partially recovered thanks to fallback SKU and CPU pool. Alex continue watch. Postmortem owners: Maria (customer impact), Emily (metrics/alerts), AJ (routing/mitigation), Sahil (operational follow-ups).

incident-bot: Incident state: SEV1 -> mitigated. Keep thread open for at least 6 hours and then file postmortem with timeline and action items.
